mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 5-year historical average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below the 5-year average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) triggers positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it indicates a coordinated policy response to economic softening that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and FEDFUNDS decline) does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 5-year moving average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as it reflects strong consumer demand and economic expansion that supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: HOUST above the 5-year average does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000.0 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) triggers negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as it indicates a severe economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings and increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO decline and GDPC1 decline) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions that disrupt economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in INDPRO fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
